cherrybekaert.name: Cherry Bekaert
cherrybekaert.text: Cherry Bekaert is a professional services firm in the United States, providing advisory, assurance, and tax solutions across the United States through two distinct entities. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, the firm employs over 2,500 people and has over 40 offices.

costco.name: Costco
costco.text: Costco Wholesale Corporation is an American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores. As of 2025, Costco is the third-largest retailer in the world, and as of August 2024, the world's largest retailer of beef, poultry, organic produce, and wine, with just under a third of American consumers regularly shopping at Costco warehouses.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.text: Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications.

onsemi.name: onsemi
onsemi.text: ON Semiconductor Corporation (stylized and doing business as onsemi) is an American semiconductor supplier company, based in Scottsdale, Arizona.
